newsitem.title: UK: Few enquiries in Europe raw cotton.
newsitem.headline: Few enquiries in Europe raw cotton.

text.p: Business in European raw cotton stayed at the seasonal low with a few enquires for prompt shipment met from old crop remnants held by the trade.
In forward activity, usual users of Uzbekistan cotton have so far been shy of tentative price ideas and await clarification of marketing policy from the authorities in Tashkent.

African Franc Zone cottons mostly provided the benchmark against which asking prices for competing new crop cottons have been judged. A strong US dollar remains a disincentive for mills to book forward requirements.
